system.description:
Materials: Wrought iron or brass frame; cylindrical glass panes; sliding metal shutters.

Physical Description: A robust, dome-topped lantern encased in a protective metal wire cage. It features a heavy wire carrying handle at the top and a glass cylinder housing the internal flame. Metal panels (the hood) are mounted on tracks, allowing them to slide down via an external lever to block or reveal the glass.

Duration: 6 hours per flask of oil
